description: This file is the main entry point for a Flutter application named 'MobileFrontend'. It defines the main() function that runs the app, and includes the root widget class MyApp which sets up the MaterialApp theme and home screen, as well as a placeholder widget._ScaffoldPlaceholder. The code establishes the basic structure of a Flutter app with placeholder UI elements intended for future development.

classes.name: MyApp

methods.name: main
